key_actions.summary: Completes the Muqaddimah, the prolegomenon to his universal history, while in retreat at the castle of Qalʿat ibn Salāma (near Frenda, modern Algeria).
Settles in Cairo under Mamluk patronage; appointed grand qadi of the Maliki school (1384, again 1399, 1401, 1402, 1404).
Negotiates with Timur outside besieged Damascus; converses with the conqueror on universal-historical themes.

name_variants: Abū Zayd ʿAbd ar-Raḥmān ibn Muḥammad ibn Khaldūn al-Ḥaḍramī
